_comment: DUAL-FOV collection: the SAME drive carries both LiDAR rigs, so the FOV is the only
difference between the two corpora it produces.
WHY. Corpora collected on different drives with different FOVs differ in both the
sensor and the drive (approach/exit balance, and the enclosure GT itself, because the
semantic LiDAR shares the FOV), so a comparison between them is not interpretable.
Two ray_cast LiDARs at the SAME spawn point, same range/channels/pps/rotation, differing
ONLY in lower_fov/upper_fov. `lidar` is the new rig and keeps the topic the rest of the
pipeline reads; `lidar_oldfov` is the old rig. One drive, two corpora, paired by
timestamp -- so a per-frame comparison is exactly paired and the drive cancels out.
ONE semantic LiDAR, on the NEW rig. Enclosure GT is sensor-dependent and would differ
between the two, but this config targets TOPOLOGY, which comes from .xodr + odometry
and is sensor-independent. Enclosure from this bag describes the new rig only; do not
